headline_stat.name: Fraction of place fields with significant negative phase-position slope

stated_limitation: The absolute preferred phase reported here is relative to the peak of the 6-10 Hz filtered signal on the selected channel and is not corrected for recording depth or the sign convention of the file, so only relative phase statements (pyramidal cells versus interneurons, or phase change across a field) should be read from the numbers. Fields whose peak falls within 15 cm of a track end are excluded because the animal never traverses them fully, and fields narrower than 15 cm, wider than 120 cm, or with fewer than 40 in-field spikes are not analysed; the remaining 155 fields are a subset of the 257 directional place fields detected. The two circular-track sessions are traversed in one direction only, so their fields contribute a single direction each.

justification.dataset: DANDI:000044 (Grosmark & Buzsaki hc-11) is the canonical dorsal-CA1 linear-track dataset for theta phase precession, and the run replicated across four sessions from three rats rather than resting on one.
justification.handling: Real data streamed from S3 with remfile, with an explicit assertion that the position timing quirk (the rate attribute is actually a sampling period) reproduces the maze epoch duration, per-session track geometry, speed thresholding, cell-type filtering, direction-split rate maps, and split-half stability as an inclusion criterion.
justification.analysis: Kempter circular-linear regression with a within-field phase shuffle null, Rayleigh tests for entrainment, and an independent lap-held-out Poisson GLM comparison; circular statistics are used correctly throughout and the shuffle distribution in fig06d directly bounds the false-positive concern about the fitted-slope asymptotic p-value.
justification.correctness: All headline values fall inside the preregistered ranges and reproduce exactly from the committed CSV, but the README rounds median rho to -0.27 where the run printed -0.26 and states the 62-75% entrainment fraction without disclosing that its denominator is pyramidal cells with at least 50 running spikes (61/90, not 61/120).
justification.figures: Nine figures with labelled axes, units, and sample sizes; examples are ranked by circular-linear correlation (the effect itself) with each panel's rho printed so the selection is transparent, and every claim in the text is visible in a figure including the shuffle overlay and the single-pass panel.
justification.honesty: The Caveats section names the phase-convention limitation, the exclusion criteria and the 155-of-257 field subset, and the one-directional circular-track sessions, and the run additionally volunteers a GLM formulation that failed and a track-range bug it had to fix; no claim exceeds what the figures and CSVs show.
